risks.title: Short-term debt refinancing
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions significant debt maturities in 2026 ($1.75B) in a high-interest-rate environment. Language emphasizes uncertainty in accessing capital markets. Recurring risk amplified by tight macroeconomic conditions. High weighting for a liquidity risk at a REIT.

risks.title: Dependence on capital market conditions
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly listed at the top of risk factors: dependence on economic conditions, REIT markets, and stock price. Strong language: 'may not be consistently available'. Less existential than refinancing but structural. Capital category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Tenant credit risk
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section on allowance for credit losses (CECL), with complex PD/LGD modeling. Explicit mention of potentially 'material' impact on results. No loss history but long lease durations. Credit category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Optional future funding commitments
risks.score_rationale: $300M of potential commitments related to Venetian, optional but binding. Mentioned in 'Additional Funding Requirements'. Cautious language but no urgency. Less critical than term debt. Capital category.

risks.title: Sensitivity to variable interest rates
risks.score_rationale: Only 0.8% of debt is variable-rate ($142.5M). Limited impact: +$1.4M/year per 100 bps increase. Mentioned in Item 7A but low exposure. Capital category, but minor risk.

risks.title: Uncertain accounting estimates on leases
risks.score_rationale: 'Critical Accounting Estimates' section on lease classification (ASC 842), with judgments on renewals and residual values. Potential 'material' impact on revenues. Cautious language but no sign of crisis. Industrial category, moderate weighting.

ai_positioning.summary: VICI does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
